purpose: Preserve the packet-proven fixed-point formula component for module effect 2104 without treating its self-only damage as rDPS.

exact_packet_ladder.independent_baseline_source: source attribute 12730 in the authoritative packet snapshot

proven: The second level-6 packet value is 275 raw fixed-point damage-zone units per exact 2300621 stack.
Effect 2300621 is attacker-scoped on each target and cannot be summed across different providers.
The module contribution is self-only and must never transfer damage credit to a different rDPS provider.
not_proven: The first packet value 2000 is not assigned a runtime formula role by this ladder alone.
Mechanically compatible ladders without an independent packet-side baseline remain candidates and are not formula authority.
